utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great — Oren’s ready at 7:30, and Hana and I leave then too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming: Sam’s helping, Tess is in, and I’m coordinating, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes — Sam’s helping, Tess is in, and you’re coordinating.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, Gus can help with the timing and stop list. That should make the carpool a lot easier to line up.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, and once it's set, Vik will let everyone know. I’ll keep an eye on Maya and Ben’s rides too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That should cover most of it, then. I’m just hoping the timing and stops stay tidy so no one gets left scrambling.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’ll pencil Bo in for around 8:00 and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Rosa — that works for me. I can cover the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. rides, and I’ll wait on Faye’s drop-off times tonight for Monday through Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Mara — thank you. I’ll let Opal know the pickup spot and 8:00 time, and I’ll update you if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did Nell get back to me about whether there’s room for one more in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I’m not sure if Nell replied yet, but I’ll check. I’ll be ready for the carpool at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks. Please check and let me know if there’s room for one more.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, that works — Jules can take Maya and Ben at 7:30 in the morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, I’ll tell everyone the 7:30 pickup time and place once it’s set.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks — that should cover it for now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Ira can help fill a seat for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, that should help. I’ll keep Gus posted if anything changes and I’ll still swing by on time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. I appreciate you keeping Gus posted.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Noah’s going to check the carpool and let me know, then I’ll pass it along to Mina.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — just let me know the pickup time, and I’ll keep Monday and Wednesday in mind.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll let you know as soon as Noah reports back on the pickup time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 8:00 works for me. Keep me posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do — I’ll help get the timing and stop list lined up, and I’ll let you know if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, thanks — 8:00 still works for me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Leo’s ready at 7:20, and Mina is meeting me for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Hana — I may be a little late again, but Quinn saving me a spot with a bit of wiggle room should help.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Okay, I’ll keep Quinn’s spot flexible and note that you may be a little late.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Noah sent me the pickup list, and I’ve got Sam down for Tuesday at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m set for 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ve got that noted for the pickup list. Thanks for confirming, Opal.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do carpool this week if the drop-off times line up with school. I’ll send Mara the times tonight, and then we can see about Monday through Thursday.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’m not sure yet if the time changed, but I’ll check and let Nell know. Cleo’s got the pickup list organized, so we should be set there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks — if the times still work, I can cover carpool this week. Let me know once you’ve checked, and I’ll send Mara the drop-off times tonight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Opal’s spot is saved, and Dane’s too — he may be a little late, but I’ll hold it. We leave by 8:10 from 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good — I’m happy to help with the carpool and I’ll be ready by 8:10 at 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect — thanks, Sam! I’ll make sure Opal and Dane have their spots, and we’ll roll out at 8:10 from 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Tuesday at 7:30 works for Sam. I’ve got the pickup list ready for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great, that still works on my end—I’ll swing by on time. If anyone drops out or anything shifts, I’ll keep Gus posted.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, I’ll let Noah know the list is set and keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, Jules can take Maya and Ben at 7:30 in the morning, so that seat’s covered.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks — I’m still waiting on Rosa to confirm the pickup spot and time, but I’ve got Quinn’s carpool list showing 14 Cedar Lane at 8:10.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Perfect, that gives us one seat sorted. I’ll keep an eye out for Rosa’s confirmation and let you know if I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did you hear back about whether there’s room for one more in the carpool?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Not yet — Noah said he’d check and let me know. I’ll report back as soon as I hear.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — please let me know as soon as you hear. I also asked Hana to confirm, so I’m checking both ways.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Mondays and Wednesdays still work for me. And 7:30 for pickup should give us enough time without rushing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I can help line up the stops and timing so it’s all set.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus — that’d be really helpful. I think we’re in good shape for Mondays and Wednesdays.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’ve got spots saved for Opal and Dane, and Dane might run a little late. Opal, I’ll leave by 8:10 from 14 Cedar Lane.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Ira can fill the extra seat if that helps. I’ll keep it quiet and let you know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks — Ira can take the extra seat if needed, and I’ll keep the spots set for Opal and Dane.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can do carpool this week if the drop-off times line up. I’ll send Mara the times tonight so we can see if Monday through Thursday works.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—please make sure the pickup time and place are clear. Vik can repeat the simple plan to everyone, and Rey can help on Monday and Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely—I’ll include the pickup time and place when I send the drop-off times tonight.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’ll be ready for the carpool at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Perfect, I’ll be there at 7:30 to help with the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, see you then — I’ll be ready at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — Leo’s ready at 7:20, and I’ll make sure Mina meets me for the carpool.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Okay, good — as long as Gus lines up the stops and timing, that should keep it from getting messy.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes — I’ll confirm the stops and timing with Gus before we leave.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Bo — Mara can cover my weekday rides at 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m., and Quinn saving me a spot with a little wiggle room helps a lot. I may be a little late again.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — 8:00 works for me. Rosa’s got me penciled in, so just keep me posted if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do — I’ll keep you posted if I’m running behind again. Appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check whether the carpool time changed and let Nell know. Cleo’s got the pickup list organized, so that should help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, thanks — once it’s set, Vik can let everyone know. I’ll keep track of Maya and Ben’s rides so we’re covered.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll check on the time and loop Nell in once I know.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can cover the 8:00 a.m. and 5:30 p.m. rides Monday through Thursday. Once Faye sends the drop-off times tonight, we can line everything up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect — Oren can help, and he’ll be ready at 7:30. Hana and I are also set to leave at 7:30.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, that should make it easy to line up the Monday through Thursday carpool once Faye sends the drop-off times tonight.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Sam is helping with it, right?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes — I’ll pencil Bo in for around 8:00 and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just to confirm — Sam’s helping, and I’m still coordinating it, right?

injected.text: Update: the morning carpool now leaves at 8am from the church parking lot, not 7am from the school lot.
